title.en: Gold v2 identity, commerce, realtime, and private classroom platform
title.zh: Gold v2 身份、商业、实时课堂与私有存储平台

purpose.en: Migrate the reviewed Gold v2 common platform to SmartLingo while preserving its independent twelve-language learning product, course model, data, credentials, and provider resources.
purpose.zh: 将已审阅的 Gold v2 公共平台迁移至 SmartLingo，同时保留其独立的十二语言学习产品、课程模型、数据、凭据及服务商资源。

en: Use fresh verified Clerk identity for administration, payment synchronization, co-host management, private-course access, and publishing actions.
Verify SmartPay3 transaction receipts, payouts, token transfers, confirmation depth, account RefID, and payer wallet before idempotently granting one course entitlement.
Allow one payer wallet to fund distinct SmartLingo accounts safely because account credit remains bound to the unique RefID rather than wallet exclusivity.
Provide generation-scoped Group Call, Webinar, and Broadcast sessions with four-tab human limits, 100-person Group capacity, nine-publisher staged capacity, and two-hour generations.
Keep silent viewers connected when a publisher leaves and add durable provider, participant, room, recording, file, and deletion recovery.
Add private course materials, multipart playlists, recording artifacts, byte-range delivery, account storage quotas, AI daily quotas, and recoverable cleanup.
zh: 对管理、付款同步、共同教师管理、专属课程访问及发布操作使用新鲜且已验证的 Clerk 身份。
在幂等授予一次课程权益前验证 SmartPay3 交易收据、分账、代币转账、确认深度、账户 RefID 及付款钱包。
允许同一付款钱包安全地为不同 SmartLingo 账户付款，因为账户入账仍绑定唯一 RefID，而不依赖钱包排他性。
提供按代际隔离的 Group Call、Webinar 与 Broadcast 会话，执行每人四标签页、Group 100 人、舞台 9 位发布者及两小时代际边界。
发布者离开时保持静默观众连接，并新增服务商、参与者、房间、录音、文件及删除流程的持久恢复。
新增私有课程材料、分片播放列表、录音产物、字节范围传输、账户存储配额、人工智能每日配额及可恢复清理。

en: SmartLingo Clerk session identity, administrator and course authorization, SmartPay3 course-payment synchronization, live classroom lifecycle, RealtimeKit media, private R2 files, recording, AI use, scheduled maintenance, and exact deployment evidence.
zh: SmartLingo Clerk 会话身份、管理员与课程授权、SmartPay3 课程付款同步、实时课堂生命周期、RealtimeKit 媒体、私有 R2 文件、录音、人工智能使用、定时维护及精确部署证据。

en: Add three additive D1 migrations for identity and commerce hardening, realtime generation state and capacity triggers, and private storage reservation ledgers.
Replace new classroom password writes with PBKDF2-SHA256 while retaining read-only compatibility for existing SHA-256 values.
Require tab-scoped participant credentials for media mutations, moderation, sharing, recording, heartbeat, and Leave.
Read back the exact newly generated participant-session id before interpreting D1 batch metadata and release provisional tab leases after failed browser joins.
Bound request bodies, provider responses and deadlines, AI daily use, account request rates, polling cadence, cron work, and R2 cleanup batches.
Replace the one-stage deployment with exact-commit validation, mutation, and Project-evidence jobs using pinned actions and migration-before-deploy ordering.
Read the public Clerk key from reviewed Worker configuration and preserve existing site-owned Clerk, AI, and WalletConnect secrets instead of requiring duplicate GitHub secret names.
Build the exact Worker before running source contracts that exercise the compiled referral redirect, so a clean CI checkout validates the same artifact as local release gates.

Resolve the reviewed site-owned RealtimeKit app by its immutable UUID from a complete paginated app page, while retaining a SmartLingo ownership-name guard instead of filtering out valid display-name variants.
Replace the nonexistent legacy smartlingo_voice preset with the verified role-matched group-call guest, participant, and host presets used as sources for Gold least-privilege audio variants.
Provision the private class-file R2 bucket idempotently through Cloudflare's exact bucket endpoint, avoiding false absence from the default 20-bucket list page.
Keep the reviewed RealtimeKit app UUID as a non-secret Worker configuration variable and write only the sensitive provider token as a Worker secret.
zh: 新增三项累加式 D1 迁移，覆盖身份与商业加固、实时房间代际状态和容量触发器，以及私有存储预留账本。
课堂密码的新写入改为 PBKDF2-SHA256，同时只读兼容既有 SHA-256 值。
媒体变更、管理、分享、录音、心跳及离开操作均要求标签页级参与者凭证。
在解释 D1 批处理元数据前回读精确的新参与者会话 ID，并在浏览器加入失败后释放临时标签租约。
限制请求体、服务商响应与超时、人工智能每日用量、账户请求频率、轮询节奏、定时任务工作量和 R2 清理批次。
以固定版本 Actions 和先迁移后部署顺序，将单阶段部署替换为精确提交验证、生产变更及 Project 证据三个任务。
从已审阅的 Worker 配置读取公开 Clerk 密钥，并保留现有站点独立 Clerk、AI 与 WalletConnect 密钥，不要求重复的 GitHub Secret 名称。
在运行会调用已编译推荐跳转的源码契约前先构建精确 Worker，使干净 CI 检出验证与本地发布门禁相同的产物。
从完整分页应用列表按不可变 UUID 解析已审阅的站点专属 RealtimeKit 应用，同时保留 SmartLingo 所属名称校验，避免有效显示名变体被错误过滤。
以已验证且角色匹配的群组通话访客、成员与主持人预设替代不存在的旧 smartlingo_voice 预设，作为 Gold 最小权限音频变体的来源。
通过 Cloudflare 精确桶接口幂等配置私有课堂文件 R2 桶，避免默认 20 桶列表分页造成的错误缺失判断。
将已审阅的 RealtimeKit 应用 UUID 保持为非敏感 Worker 配置变量，仅把敏感服务商令牌写为 Worker Secret。

en: Replay all 72 migrations into an empty isolated D1 twice and verify the Gold v2 identity, lifecycle, capacity, storage, and cleanup objects with no foreign-key violations.

Pass every source contract test, SmartPay3 compilation, TypeScript, zero-warning ESLint, production build, rendered Worker test, artifact validation, runtime-layout verification, and git whitespace check.
Preserve the 48,000-item, twelve-language vocabulary catalog, published pronunciation metadata, difficulty, frequency, grade-level, learning, referral, and certificate boundaries.

Require GitHub Actions to verify the dedicated SmartLingo RealtimeKit app and presets before production mutation, deploy the exact commit, probe apex/www and protected routes, and publish matching Project evidence.
zh: 在空白隔离 D1 中两次重放全部 72 项迁移，并验证 Gold v2 身份、生命周期、容量、存储及清理对象，且无外键违规。
通过全部源码契约测试、SmartPay3 编译、TypeScript、零警告 ESLint、生产构建、渲染 Worker 测试、产物验证、运行布局验证及 Git 空白检查。
保留 48,000 项十二语言词汇目录、已发布发音元数据、难度、频率、年级、学习、推荐及证书边界。
要求 GitHub Actions 在生产变更前验证 SmartLingo 专属 RealtimeKit 应用与预设，部署精确提交，探测 apex/www 及受保护路由，并发布匹配的 Project 证据。

en: Safari production acceptance starts after deployment; four-person realtime streaming remains intentionally deferred until the user switches to SOL High, when Chrome will be used only for that multi-session case.
No SmartMeeting, SmartNCT, or GeniusWallet production member data, credentials, provider identifiers, prices, contracts, or release history are copied.
zh: 部署后开始 Safari 正式站验收；四人实时串流按约定延后至用户切换 SOL High，届时仅该多会话场景使用 Chrome。
不复制 SmartMeeting、SmartNCT 或 GeniusWallet 的生产会员数据、凭据、服务商标识、价格、合约或发布历史。

en: Preserve SmartLingo branding, twelve-language navigation, fixed official courses, vocabulary and sentence catalogs, learning paths, AI partners, score history, referrals, certificates, and education disclaimers.
Map shared meeting concepts to SmartLingo Course, classroom, teacher, co-host, learner, and /classrooms routes.

Retain SmartLingo-owned Clerk application, D1 database, R2 buckets, RealtimeKit app and credentials, SmartPay3 contract, token settings, wallets, course prices, GitHub repository, Cloudflare Worker, and domains.
zh: 保留 SmartLingo 品牌、十二语言导航、固定正式课程、词汇与句子目录、学习路径、人工智能伙伴、分数历史、推荐、证书及教育免责声明。
将共享会议概念适配为 SmartLingo 的课程、课堂、教师、共同教师、学员及 /classrooms 路由。
保留 SmartLingo 独立拥有的 Clerk 应用、D1 数据库、R2 存储桶、RealtimeKit 应用与凭据、SmartPay3 合约、代币设置、钱包、课程价格、GitHub 仓库、Cloudflare Worker 和域名。

rollback.en: The Gold v2 schema changes are additive except for the wallet-binding key migration. Roll back the Worker first; preserve Gold v2 tables and columns for forward recovery, and restore the prior one-wallet-per-account binding table only from a verified pre-migration D1 backup if a full data rollback is explicitly required.
rollback.zh: Gold v2 架构除钱包绑定主键迁移外均为累加式。回退时先恢复上一版 Worker；保留 Gold v2 表与字段以便向前恢复，仅在明确需要完整数据回退时，才从已验证的迁移前 D1 备份恢复原有每账户一钱包绑定表。
